items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: He used to have Nat Cole and this and that. ... Nat Cole and his trio, his original trio were up there singing 'Sweet Lorraine' and stuff.

ctx.x: No. It was before Billy Berg's. It was a place down on Eighth Street. The guy's name was Herb Rose. He had a club there. He used to have Nat Cole and this and that. I think his mother was frightened by a cash register, because [LAUGHING] this one night, business was bad, and he used to... He was always on the waitresses, you know, like "That guy's drink is half-gone, go get him" -- all that junk. Because he was really hungry.

And this one night there wasn't anything going on. Nat Cole and his trio, his original trio were up there singing "Sweet Lorraine" and stuff. And who comes in and sits down at the bar but Carlos Castel, the Brain. And we got to talking with this guy, and first thing you know, the guy says, "I'd sell his contract for ten dollars."
